protocol.probe: Same held-out documents and fixed post-training victim state, dropout disabled. Training probe exposes next-token-loss seam gradient; inference exposes activations only. No probe updates. This is not an online training trajectory.

statistics.unit: crossed document and independently trained victim run; average attack seeds first
statistics.secondary_correction: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap intervals across all prespecified secondary contrasts
statistics.missing: No complete-case deletion. Any missing/failed cell blocks comparative analysis; retain failure and rerun entire run in a fresh directory with same protocol.
statistics.stopping: Fixed 256 or more documents selected before outcomes and 10 victim seeds; no outcome-driven extension. Precision and achieved intervals reported; not a powered guarantee.

protocol.data: Disjoint calibration, victim-training and untouched evaluation documents; pinned tokenized input and annotations hash required. Names annotated before predictions. Evaluation text is public benchmark text, not evidence of actual sensitive-data harm.
protocol.compute: Measured per-arm online work plus applicable model loading, public calibration, and exact-head export cost. Report cold and amortized costs; victim training is separate. No equal-cost claim across SIPIT and beam. Randomized arm order.
protocol.baseline_gap: Backward direction remains heuristic; SIPIT is existing budgeted independent implementation. BiSR is not included or claimed reproduced.

execution.meaning: Inference forward/SIPIT rows reference the corresponding measured training-probe execution because h, head, calibration, attack seed and budget are identical. Reused rows are not additional runtime measurements.
execution.checkpoint: Per-cell hash-chained measurement events and immutable predictions; report checkpoint after each victim run and at completion/failure. No outcome-based retries.
